firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited Yokohama starts; if that does not determine a player, choose one by any preferred method.
clarifications: Give that player the Start Player card. It stays with them for the whole game.
The starting player begins with three yen; every other player starts with four.
internalEvidence: Rendered page 3 gives the Yokohama-visit criterion and flexible fallback; page 4 gives initial money. Page 16 credits OKAZU Brand. Area boards, President pawns and trading-house sites match inventory BGG 196340. SHA-256: 4a6377da566e7d1e5c2b26e9981aef48fbc0eff0ac47f959fa6db5e80aa7519f. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: The fallback is intentionally open-ended; the rules do not prescribe a tie procedure.
